verdict.rationale: First-party docs say ChatGPT can schedule recurring tasks to run in the background, with a Scheduled view for active, paused and completed tasks and their recent runs. Scheduled tasks can also start on Gmail, Slack or GitHub events. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of one-off (non-recurring) scheduling, detail on how results are delivered or notified back to the user, independent or hands-on corroboration.
